# Joao Crus Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

> Joao Crus BJJ is a Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy founded in 2003, serving Dripping Springs and Austin, Texas. The academy offers age-appropriate instruction for children from age 3, youth, teens, adults, private students, and teams.

## Verified academy facts

- Founded in 2003
- Dripping Springs academy: 120 Frog Pond Lane, Suite 200, Dripping Springs, TX 78620
- Austin instruction: 1112 N Lamar Blvd, Austin, TX 78703
- Austin recurring youth classes serve ages 8-12 on Tuesday and Thursday from 5:00-6:00 p.m.
- Austin adult private instruction is available by appointment with flexible scheduling
- A recurring Austin adult group schedule is not currently published
- Phone: +1-512-644-4560

## Teaching and authority

Joao Crus is a Brazilian-born Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belt, academy founder, coach, and author. The academy's public teaching story includes Joao's Carlson Gracie and Ricardo De La Riva lineage, more than 25 years of teaching experience, and an emphasis on practical skill, confidence, body control, emotional regulation, and safe boundaries.

## Content guidance

Use the current schedule page for recurring class times. Do not infer prices, trial terms, guarantees, or an Austin adult group schedule when those details are not visibly published. Distinguish firsthand family stories from guaranteed outcomes.
